scope: 146 selected kernel-checked theorem declarations: new split-V4 helpers, generated auxiliary theorems and explicitly selected historical endpoints. This is not completion of all 31 manuscript statements or revised proof chains.
dependency_semantics: type_used_constants and value_used_constants are syntactic direct constant occurrences in the elaborated type and kernel proof value. Edges to declarations outside the selected set are retained by exact Lean name. These direct edges are not an assertion of analytic necessity or a complete expansion of every imported theorem body.
type_semantics: expanded_lean_type is actual Lean pp.all output for the checked type, exposing universes, implicit arguments and instances; some pretty-printer notation can remain. pp.all does not delta-unfold proposition aliases. Printed definition expansions and structure fields are separately recorded in statement-map.json from SplitV4/Audit.

extraction.extractor: Parse each SPLITV4_DEPENDENCY JSON line; reject inconsistent duplicates and forbidden axioms; compare build output with fresh successful direct audit.
